metadata.description: Plan a database schema, data, or API migration before it runs - compatibility between old and new code, clients, and data, validation of existing data, deployment order (expand, migrate, contract), backfills, and per-step recovery - stating explicitly which steps lose data or cannot be reversed. Use when the user asks to plan, sequence, roll out, roll back, or de-risk a migration, a schema change such as renaming, retyping, or dropping a column or table, a backfill, or a breaking API change. Not for listing everything a finished change could break (checking-blast-radius), recording a decision already made (recording-decisions), or resolving git merge conflicts.
